messages:
mike: Heads-up proposal: introduce a 'debug-retain-lite' flow for sparse error cases. Keep a route-scoped 96-byte prefix + tenant-scoped HMAC fingerprint for 48h. Never persist embeddings or model outputs. Thoughts?
elaine: Love the idea. Two quick asks: 1) default OFF per-tenant, 2) explicit opt-in UI with consent copy.
frank: Agree on opt-in. Also suggest we pseudonymize any detected high-cardinality ids before storing prefixes.
dan: Ops: add a per-tenant hourly storage cap and a clear fallback when cap hit (fall back to no-retain and emit metric). We can't let retention stall inference.
mike: Good points. Sketch config: 
```
retention: {
  enabled: false,
  prefix_bytes: 96,
  fingerprint_algo: "hmac-sha256-trunc12",
  ttl_hours: 48,
  embeddings_strip: true,
  per_tenant_hourly_cap_bytes: 2000000
}
```
elaine: UX: console should show a "debug-retain-lite" badge in request detail and a small card in route settings with current window usage + request bump button (SSO approval). Also tooltip: "Only short prefix and non-reversible fingerprint retained."
frank: Security: tenant HMAC keys must be KMS-backed and rotated quarterly. Also include a collision test for truncated fingerprints.
dan: Metric names: retention.kept, retention.denied.cap, retention.fallback.no_store. Emit retention.denied.alert when remaining <5%.
sec-bot: security-scan: flagged missing KMS rotation policy (ticket SEC-5001). Breakglass workflow required for full inspect (ticket SEC-5002).
mike: Breakglass: support can request full inspect with customer-signed consent; approval via SSO, TTL-limited, audited. We'll add auto-pseudonymization before granting view.
elaine: Legal wants the consent wording on the opt-in modal. I'll sync with them and add to the PR.
frank: Implementation note: preprocessing pipeline must drop any model outputs and vectors before storing. Embeddings route should be excluded entirely.
mike: I'll open RFC PR with middleware + small e2e tests: prefix stored, fingerprint present, ttl honoured, embeddings removed, cap enforcement. Will include SEC tickets.
ux-bot: mockup request: small badge + hover copy + usage chart. I'll post mocks once RFC lands.
dan: sgtm. schedule canary once PR merged.
mike: Thanks all. Follow-ups in-thread.
